head: Blueger returns to Vancouver
paras: The Maple Leafs come in at 7-6-2, the Canucks at 3-10-1.
At home, Manny Malhotra likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Maple Leafs’ fourth line. Don’t read much into Bobrovsky’s record against the Canucks.

items.text: Teddy Blueger faces Vancouver for the first time since leaving.

The Maple Leafs are newly without Kirill Marchenko and Nick Blankenburg, and have been without Chris Tanev and John Tavares for several games. Counting how much each missing player usually brings, no team is missing more right now.
The Canucks have been without Thatcher Demko all season.
William Nylander has four goals in six games against Vancouver since 2023-24.

VAN.head: The Canucks face a real test
VAN.body: Toronto has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately, but they will be without Marchenko, and Vancouver has home-ice advantage. The Canucks’ best way through is a power play that gets going.

TOR.head: The matchup suits the Maple Leafs
TOR.body: Toronto has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately, but they will be without Marchenko, and Vancouver has home-ice advantage. The Canucks can make it interesting if their power play gets going.

calls.head: The Canucks like Sasson’s line against Groulx’s
calls.body: At home, the Canucks keep sending Sasson’s line (Bains, Sasson and Gallagher) out against opponents’ fourth lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Manny Malhotra keeps choosing line for line. Tonight the Maple Leafs’ fourth line is Groulx, Sissons and Lettieri.

calls.head: The Canucks don’t own Bobrovsky
calls.body: Bobrovsky has been shaky against the Canucks since 2023-24, well below his usual. But three seasons of data say a goalie’s record against one team tells us nothing about the next meeting, so don’t be surprised if he looks like himself tonight.

calls.head: Special teams lean toward the Maple Leafs
calls.body: The Maple Leafs’ power play is near the top of the league, and the Canucks’ kill is the worst. Every trip to the box hurts the Canucks more than most.

calls.head: The Canucks roll four lines, the Maple Leafs lean on their top six
calls.body: On depth, Vancouver is near the top of the league, but Toronto is one of the worst. If this one comes down to the bottom six, that suits the Canucks.
